narrative_purpose: The chapter's cover: Pandora seen whole from space, where the single most telling feature is a bright band of cloud wrapped around the equator - the visible signature of the circulation that places all its forests and seas.
subject: A blue-green moon seen from high above space, filling most of the frame as a great curved sphere. One large landmass cloaked in deep teal rainforest sits below the middle; a vast dark ocean spreads beside it; and a single broad, bright belt of white-and-teal cloud wraps all the way around the moon's equator like a sash. The huge curved edge of a banded gas giant intrudes from one far corner.
scene: Open space above the moon, deep and black, a scatter of faint stars, the gas giant's pale banded limb glowing softly at the corner.
camera: Distant orbital view looking down on the whole moon, the sphere gently curved, slight three-quarter tilt.
light: A single off-frame star lights one side of the moon; the bioluminescent forests give the night side a faint inner teal glow.
palette: Cool void-indigo space, deep ocean-teal seas, living-teal forests, a bright misty-cyan equatorial cloud band; the gas giant a muted amber-grey.
style: Painterly naturalist plate, hand-painted planetary portrait, soft atmospheric haze at the limb, NOT a photograph or 3D render.
detail_level: High on the moon's surface texture and cloud band, softening into haze at the curved edge.
composition: The moon dominant and centred, the bright equatorial cloud band as the clear horizontal feature, gas-giant limb anchoring one corner, generous black negative space.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette locked to the style anchor; the equatorial cloud band is the recurring motif of the chapter. Crisp focal portrait suitable as a thumbnail.
